coverage.description: sentence visits frames in order with one-based output rows. Missing subject on Fact Is/IsA or non-Bare verb be emits copula-no-who. A time_word place emits time-in-where. Equal nonempty ASCII-insensitive agent/patient IDs emit who-is-what except reflexive patient surface/pronoun or both unresolved bare entities. Checks are diagnostic hypotheses for teacher review.
